Description.SourceString:
Not all threats stay up close and personal. This, the KotHaar learned early on in their existence, so they created the KotHaar-XIl caste to handle more distant threats. Their accuracy is terrifying and they hurl their weapons with such force that it could tear through any armour.

In times gone by, they would stand for days on end, at key points around the entrances to their tunnels. Here they would tirelessly keep vigil, never wavering, never getting bored, focused exclusively on protecting the Lens from any that would do it harm, or seek to gain it.

Only now do they waver in their task, bound as they are by Fuzan’s will.

If you watch them carefully, you might spot their eyes glancing toward Fuzan’s tower, still dedicated to protecting the Lens from danger. Even if Fuzan puppets their actions, the core of their being still sticks to its task.
